definitions.explanation: The coldest period of winter, typically January and February in Japan.

examples.japanese: {真冬|まふゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The cold in midwinter is harsh.

examples.japanese: {真冬|まふゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I jog every morning even in the dead of winter.

examples.japanese: {真冬|まふゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧{二十度|にじゅうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In midwinter Hokkaido, the temperature can drop below minus twenty degrees.

notes:
Composed of {真|ま} (true, peak) + ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧ (winter). The prefix {真|ま} intensifies the noun, indicating the height or peak of the season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真冬|まふゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧ (midwinter cold)
- {真冬|まふゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (midwinter sky)
- {真冬|まふゆ}{日和|びより} (fine midwinter day)
- {真冬|まふゆ}{並|な}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧ (cold like midwinter)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧ — midsummer (same {真|ま} prefix pattern)
- {真春|まはる} — not commonly used (spring lacks this pattern)
- ⟦{厳冬|げんとう}→厳冬：08556_gentou⟧ — severe winter (more formal/literary)
- ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧ — peak winter, winter in full swing
